quote: “Francesco's approach to design is multifaceted and incisive. To work with, he's a careful listener, independent, and can deliver work which is incredibly considered and pointed, whilst having a warm and heartfelt simplicity.”

quote: “Francesco has the rare talent of being able to embed himself in a niche that he previously knew nothing about, quickly understanding the intricacies and writing with the confidence of an insider.”
